overview.description: The 21Shares Hyperliquid Staking ETF (THYP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long hype, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of the US dollar price of the HYPE token through an ETF structure. The Custodian holds most HYPE and their private keys in cold storage (offline). THYP was launched on May 11, 2026 and is issued by 21Shares.
